    AI Overview
    Yes,
    Celebrity Jeopardy! is back for its fourth season    , featuring an "All-Stars" tournament that premiered on Friday, March 13, 2026, on ABC. The new season features returning champions—including Ike Barinholtz, Lisa Ann Walter, and W. Kamau Bell—competing alongside new celebrity contestants. New episodes are available to stream the next day on Hulu. 
    Watch this interview with host Ken Jennings about the new season:
    04:55
    ABC News
    YouTube• Mar 12, 2026
    Key Details for Season 4: 
    • Host: Ken Jennings hosts this season.
    • Format: The season features 21 returning celebrity contestants in an All-Stars tournament format
      .
    • Twists: The "Triple Jeopardy" format is introduced, increasing the stakes and allowing for larger point totals.
    • Lineup: Participants include Mark Duplass, Rachel Dratch, Macaulay Culkin, Cynthia Nixon, Ray Romano, and others.
    • Schedule: Episodes air on Friday nights on ABC and can be streamed on Hulu.
